calibration.stability_note: energy drop on relaxation only; no hull energy, so stability is not claimed

dataset.name: MP-20
dataset.source: Materials Project, structures of at most 20 atoms (the MP-20 benchmark split)

headline: Requested band gap in, relaxed structures out: 7 accepted from 175 generated, 3 new compositions, and known compounds returned at their recorded gaps; 20 of the 37 relaxed cells collapsed and were set aside.
limits: Serviceable range 1–3 eV; above 3 eV the generator saturates.
Resolution about 1 eV; precision ±0.7 eV per structure.
The generated cell is a starting point: relaxation lowers the energy by 1.3–8.7 eV/atom and moves atoms 1.4–2.3 Å; the relaxed cell is the product.

20 of the 37 relaxed cells collapsed (closest atoms under 0.6 of their radii; a sound crystal is near 1) and are set aside: the accepted structures and every calibration number come from the 17 that stayed physical.
No hull energy is computed: nothing here is called stable.
Coordinate accuracy (RMSE 0.24) is the open defect; a Wyckoff-letter head is the identified fix.
title: MP-20

S0.note: 817 compositions per element (rule: 200); mode decided as generation; 68% of gaps are zero

S1.note: held-out band-gap MAE 0.27 eV, formation energy 0.054 eV/atom (baseline 0.26 / 0.047)

S3.note: template-free valid cells 63% (free decoder 2%), 55 space groups, space group exact 68%; composition exact 12%; coordinate RMSE 0.24

S4.note: label read from the returned cell; agrees with the independent judge within 0.5 eV for 19 of 22

S5.note: target anchor only (latent refinement removed: semiconductor share 20% → 42–62%); one anion required; cell capped

S6.note: independent judge against the request: 1.10 eV on generated cells, 0.80 eV on the 17 relaxed cells that stayed physical; two-judge consensus yield 0.21

S7.note: two potentials relax all 37 consensus cells; 20 collapse (closest atoms under 0.6 of their radii) and are set aside; novel 88% of the accepted-window cells; no hull energy computed

S8.note: MEGNet qualified on this dataset: MAE 0.102 eV = 0.073 of the gap spread (pass ≤ 0.5); PBE head chosen by measurement

S9.note: the support proxy calls 0–6 eV servable; the measured range 0.5–3.0 eV supersedes it
